observed_strengths: Can body is one connected 16-segment all-quad radial shell rather than stacked cylinder primitives.
Pull tab is one manifold quad shell with two actual openings.
Lid, tab, and pin are separate only where manufacturing and motion justify separation.
Subdivision and bevel modifiers remain live and unapplied.
The v1 lid-gap, bulbous-base, and torus-rivet failures were corrected after solid-render inspection.
limitations: The pull-tab outline and pressed recess are simplified relative to the tutorial blueprint.
The tutorial's manual Grid Fill and Profile-1 holding-edge demonstrations are represented by equivalent all-quad cages and live modifiers, not claimed as exact hand-action replay.
No materials, UVs, labels, or production high/low pair are included because this lesson is a modeling/topology exercise.

transfer.result: Support distribution preserved more of the intended bounding volume on unrelated bottle geometry.
transfer.counterevidence: The support-distributed variant produced 128 evaluator pinch candidates around one clustered transition ring; the MatCap render must arbitrate whether that ring is intentional or over-constrained.
transfer.promoted_rule: Add or redistribute loops only where silhouette, quad aspect ratio, or highlight behavior demonstrates a need; then inspect the evaluated surface. More loops alone are not quality.

next_lesson_gate: Proceed to a beginner/intermediate tutorial that requires connected planar-to-curved topology and manual loop redirection; do not resume held-out prop benchmarks yet.
